scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d && docker-compose logs -f backend frontend ai-agents
scripts.db:migrate: docker-compose exec backend npm run migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker-compose exec backend npm run seed
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose exec backend npm run db:reset
scripts.test: docker-compose exec backend npm test && docker-compose exec ai-agents  npm test/ -v
scripts.shell:postgres: docker-compose exec postgres postgres -U BD-crm_user -d BD-crm
